slides.title: Pointer Fundamentals
slides.prompt: A pointer stores the memory address of another variable. '&' gets the address, and '*' dereferences the pointer.

slides.title: Address-Of Operator
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator used to get the memory address of a variable.

slides.title: Dereferencing Behavior
slides.prompt: What happens when you execute '*ptr = 20;' assuming 'ptr' points to variable 'a'?
options: Modifies the value stored in variable 'a' to 20
Changes 'ptr' to point to memory address 20
Creates a new variable with value 20
slides.correctAnswer: Modifies the value stored in variable 'a' to 20

slides.title: Null Pointer Constant
slides.prompt: Fill in the C++11 keyword used to represent a null pointer safely.

slides.title: Uninitialized Pointers
slides.prompt: What happens if you dereference an uninitialized raw pointer ('int* p;')?
options: Undefined behavior or potential Segmentation Fault
slides.correctAnswer: Undefined behavior or potential Segmentation Fault

slides.title: Pointer Type Declaration
slides.prompt: Fill in the correct data type declaration for a pointer pointing to a double.

slides.title: Pointer Memory Size
slides.prompt: What determines the size in bytes of a pointer variable in C++?
options: The system architecture (e.g., 8 bytes on 64-bit systems)
The size of the data type it points to
The value stored inside the variable
It is always fixed at 4 bytes on all devices
slides.correctAnswer: The system architecture (e.g., 8 bytes on 64-bit systems)

slides.title: Changing Pointer Value
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator to update the value of the target variable directly.

slides.title: Checking Nullptr Before Access
slides.prompt: Why is it important to check if a pointer is 'nullptr' before dereferencing it?
options: To prevent application crashes and segmentation fault exceptions
To speed up program execution time
To automatically free memory when zero
To enable implicit conversion to boolean
slides.correctAnswer: To prevent application crashes and segmentation fault exceptions

slides.title: Boolean Evaluation of Pointer
slides.prompt: Fill in missing check condition for valid pointer.
